whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Baked with Sneh,

I noticed your bakery has exceptional 4.9★ reviews in the Fraser Road Area, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for custom cake orders and menu browsing.

Maine aapke bakery ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp cake booking, custom flavor menu, aur gallery integrate ki hai:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/bakedwithsneh

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Baked with Sneh team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke bakery ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp custom cake ordering and a stunning dessert gallery for your Fraser Road location. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact cake varieties, actual photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
